title: Household Annual Fee Cap on Participation Fees: Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
Under **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees**, participation fees are capped per household per school year at the household annual fee cap of the activity type, counted after meal-status waivers. Travel fees, uniform packages, trip fees, late registration fees and equipment charges never count toward the cap and are never reduced by it.

## The cap credit

When a participation fee is charged, the household's participation fees already charged this school year, net of waiver and cap credits, plus this participation fee net of its own waiver, are compared with the cap. If that total exceeds the cap, the excess is credited on this fee as a household cap credit.

- **Fees already charged** are the participation fees on the household's other participations of the school year of the fee being charged that were posted earlier, less the free-meal waiver, reduced-price meal waiver and household cap credits posted against them.
- **The cap credit** is the higher of zero and the amount by which the fees already charged plus this fee net of its own waiver exceed the cap.
- **Timing.** The cap is computed from fees posted earlier. A later fee never changes a cap credit already posted, and a fee credited later for a cut or withdrawal does not reopen cap room for credits already posted.

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical amounts, cap of 300.00)

| Fees already charged this school year, net | This participation fee net of its own waiver | Total | Household cap credit on this fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| 251.40 | 42.10 | 293.50 | 0.00 |
| 271.25 | 42.50 | 313.75 | 13.75 |
| 257.90 | 42.10 | 300.00 | 0.00 (the total does not exceed the cap) |

## Points of judgement

- Only participation fees enter the comparison; a travel fee of the same household in the same school year neither uses cap room nor receives a cap credit.
- A household cap credit posted on an earlier fee stays as posted when a later fee is charged, and when an earlier fee is later credited for a cut or a withdrawal.
